notes.title: Fix for Navigation Update
notes.notes:
Stamina regain now is faster than previous build
 Compass & Mini map fixed
 Night time is now brighter and includes a nice stary sky
 Clues now are visible no matter what order you collect them
 Clues now have a hint popup when you can pick them up

notes.title: Ease of Navigation Update
notes.notes:
Found yourself wandering throughout the map and have no idea where you are? Worry no more, you will now have a easier time! 

The update will include these features as well as some minor bug fixes.

Bug Fixes

 Collision on rocks fixed near one of the first houses you come across.
 Deer now run away


New Content

 Minimap and compass added for ease of Navigation
 Controls can be viewed on the fly by pressing F1
